acceptance.actor: No model feedback or review is relabelled as human authorship/approval.
acceptance.duplicates: Review every record, link shared ancestry, do not count duplicated claims as distinct independent cases.
acceptance.every_approved_case: Exact source/runtime provenance, reproducible baseline failure and matched repaired or correct-output control; no timeout, unavailable environment or writes masquerading as regression.
acceptance.unsupported: Root-cause inferences, unavailable historical state, non-authoritative cost/caching claims and missing tools remain refused/unassessed.

registration_timing: Frozen full inventory precedes content inspection; this formal first-20 review protocol follows initial text inspection. This is a retrospective consecutive census, not a blinded prospective study.
selection: First 20 records by original created_at then id from the complete frozen 42-record default personal ledger; no exclusions by outcome or model claims. All later records retained but not substituted.
source_exposure: Developer-visible historic sessions and already published/promoted cases remain development material. No independent confirmation claim.
timing: Historical per-item curation times are unavailable; current review lacks independent per-item timing. Do not infer the median from file timestamps or claim the 30-minute endpoint.
